title: Dances and dance tunes at the Victoria
summary: Popular numbers included Stardust and Sweet Georgia Brown; people danced the Charleston, rhumba and Black Bottom.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: What were people dancing at that time? What were some of the popular dances of that day?
"Stardust." "Sweet Georgia Brown." The Blues, of course. All the popular numbers we played...
What about the dance steps? What kinds of dance steps are we talking about?
Well, during that time it was... That's during the time the Charleston was very popular.
Oh, the Charleston was still popular.
The Charleston, yeah. A lot of time... We didn't have to actually play (?) time goes down. We did a lot of rhumbas.
We played a lot of rhumbas.
Was the Black Bottom popular then?
Yeah, very popular. Black Bottom. In fact, there was a tune wrote... I don't know who wrote the tune.
